snippet.title: American Truck Simulator - Introducing South Dakota
snippet.description:
We are excited to unveil our next map expansion for American Truck Simulator, which will offer a blend of beautiful nature, vibrant cities, and the joy of the open road. Our teams are currently hard at work on South Dakota for American Truck Simulator!

Read more on our blog 👉 https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/introducing-south-dakota.html

Add this DLC to your Steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749870/#game_area_purchase
